D: A comfortable champion loses his edge and has to train with his old rival to win it back.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky and Apollo start training at the LA gym.
S: Rocky made it big, but he's still from Philly

Ciabatta grilled until charred, rubbed with garlic and piled with ripe tomato, basil, olive oil and sea salt, finished with shaved parmesan. Slice a ciabatta into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill until charred. Rub each piece with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes, mix with torn basil, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, a splash of balsamic and sea salt, and rest 10 minutes. Pile on the bread just before serving and top with shaved parmesan.
training on the beach in Los Angeles
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm tortillas with cabbage, lime crema and salsa.
the old Los Angeles gym where Apollo started out

Chicken thighs marinated in chilli, lime and garlic, grilled until charred and chopped, on small corn tortillas with onion, coriander and a smoky salsa roja. Marinate 700g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and oil. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and chop. Char 3 tomatoes and a soaked dried chilli, then blitz with a garlic clove and salt for salsa. Warm 16 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, diced white onion, coriander and salsa.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with brown rice, broccoli and a squeeze of lemon. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.
Adrian and the family in Philadelphia

Pork shoulder, Italian sausages and meatballs browned and simmered for hours in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, served over rigatoni with parmesan. Brown 600g pork shoulder in chunks and 4 Italian sausages in olive oil. Mix 400g beef mince with an egg, 50g breadcrumbs and parmesan, roll into balls and brown. Soften 4 garlic cloves, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 250ml water and basil. Return all the meat and simmer gently for 3 hours, covered. Serve over 500g rigatoni with grated parmesan.
W: Savoiardi dipped in espresso, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa on top. Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi biscuits briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, finish with cream, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.
K: the sprints on the sand with Apollo
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water stirred in a big jug with bruised mint and plenty of ice.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.
